Another Year Of Findom

2021 · 6m · 1080p

Financial Domination

Financial DominationFemdom POV

Description

Another year has passed. A new one’s just started. What have you done with your life this year, and what do you plan to do with it in the upcoming one? Shut the fuck up. That’s rhetorical. I’ll tell you. You spent the last year paying me. You gave me what you judged yourself capable of giving. That’s good. What about this coming year though? You’re going to strive to top yourself. You're going to crank up the dial. You’re going to redefine the practical meaning of that word “capable” in terms of your contributions to my massive wealth. You’re going to improve yourself in this way, and this way only. What’s more, it’s going to feel fucking good. Get ready for your best year of findom yet.

Best for scanning many covers. Click or press Space to inspect. Escape returns focus and scroll position to the selected film.

Tradeoff: comparing several films means moving in and out of Quick Look. Within Quick Look, left/right switches preview moments.

Library stopped

M1-asahi · HDD unmounted

Recommended for frequent previewing. Selecting another film updates one inspector. Space enlarges the preview without losing your place.

Tradeoff: fewer covers fit across the window. Grid arrows select films; preview arrows change moments only when the preview has focus.

Native behavior to validate

  • Start, stop, failed connection, missing HDD, and canceling a stop during playback.
  • Closing the window versus quitting the app, with clear handling of an active stream.
  • Focus restoration, keyboard navigation, readable descriptions, narrow windows, and long titles.
  • Existing folders, categories, sorts, saved lists, and artist browsing remain available.

Performance checks for the build

  • Load only nearby covers, bound the decoded-image cache, and cancel obsolete requests.
  • One preview player, audio at 40%, first moment by default, play once.
  • Measure scroll hitches, search latency, CPU, and memory after repeated browsing and preview changes.
  • Verify that idle state produces no background HDD reads. No hardware-sleep claim from unreliable SMART readings.

These are implementation criteria. No SwiftUI runtime or memory results are claimed by this mock.

Reference: Netflix image-led grid on Mobbin. Native title bar, sidebar, Quick Look and inspector are proposed macOS adaptations. Sample covers come from the existing approved local comparison. Buttons simulate layout states only; no server, playback, or disk actions occur.
